title: Lifting invariant measures through coding trees
exact_target: Can all invariant ergodic measures, or all those with positive entropy, be obtained from symbolic measures through a nearby coding tree? Ask the same two questions for measures on rational Julia sets.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300052 (AMR-052-0052). CC BY 4.0.
